    a = [int(x) for x in input_data[1:]]

            if a[i] % 2 == 0:
                can_divide.append(i)
        
        if not can_divide:

        # We must choose at least one "divide by 2" operation per round
        # Since we want to maximize total operations, we perform exactly one round

        count += 1
        
        # Perform the division on all numbers in can_divide
